payload.core_mechanism_summary: Use a 1D DP array where dp[i] = length of longest non-decreasing subarray ending at i; dp[i] = dp[i-1] + 1 if A[i] >= A[i-1] else 1. Total count is sum(dp).
payload.rationale: The solution linearly scans and maintains a simple state: length of current non-decreasing run. This is archetypal 1D DP with O(N) time and space. No other DP subtype fits better.
